text.tspan: MASS SYNC
@liuzhen9320 single-handedly syncs 126 files in opengrok, adding 7,423 lines in one PR
TUESDAY VANISHED
@liuzhen9320 commits literally nothing on Tuesday. Even the code took a day off.
FRIDAY SURGE
@liuzhen9320 drops 3 commits before the weekend, then vanishes until Sunday
NO REVIEWS
@liuzhen9320 reviews zero PRs this week. Entirely consumed by own sync operation.
STILL OPEN
@liuzhen9320's 126-file sync PR remains unmerged. Coworkers awaiting merge with bated breath.
ZERO ISSUES
@liuzhen9320 opens and closes zero issues. Pure commit-only week, no bug tracking whatsoever.
